name: Oklahoma Tax Commission (individual income tax)
notes: Researched from public oklahoma.gov/tax pages only. OkTAP: pay online 24/7 and request payment plans (Letter ID from the billing letter gives access; prompts decide eligibility). Mail: Form 511-V to PO Box 26890, Oklahoma City, OK 73126-0890. Contracted collection agencies (Harris & Harris 855-443-1919; LGBS 877-304-6848); OTC Collections 405-521-2212. Penalty: one-time 5% on tax unpaid by the original due date plus interest of 1.25% per month. Card and e-check fees are not published on the pages read (fees.notes only). The OkTAP help pages could not be read (search budget exhausted), so sign-in by username, no AutoPay and guest pay without login are inferred from the OkTAP payment link.

guest_pay.note: Pay taxes online in OkTAP, 24 hours a day.

autopay.note: OkTAP has no recurring automatic payments for an income tax balance. Pay what you can, or request a payment plan in OkTAP after you receive a bill.

payment_arrangement.note: Use the Letter ID on your billing letter to request a payment plan in OkTAP; the prompts show whether you qualify.

notes: Processing fees for card and electronic check payments in OkTAP are shown during payment; the Tax Commission does not publish the amounts on its payment page.

help.title: Pay individual income tax
paragraphs: Make a payment online 24/7 in OkTAP, the Tax Commission's online system.
To pay by mail after filing your current-year return, send your check with Form 511-V to Oklahoma Tax Commission, PO Box 26890, Oklahoma City, OK 73126-0890.
Some past-due accounts are handled by contracted collection agencies. To check that an agency is working for the Tax Commission or to dispute an account, call OTC Collections at 405-521-2212.

help.title: If you cannot pay in full
paragraphs: Pay what you can with your return. You will then receive a billing notice for the remaining tax, penalty and interest.
You can request a payment plan in OkTAP using the Letter ID from your billing letter; follow the prompts to see whether you qualify. For other arrangements, call the number on your billing notice.
Tax not paid by the original due date gets a one-time 5% delinquent penalty plus interest of 1.25% per month.

extra.intent: Using the Oklahoma Tax Commission website's help pages, find the monthly interest rate charged on unpaid individual income tax. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Unpaid tax accrues interest of 1.25% per month after a one-time 5% penalty.
